events.description: A vehicle (likely a truck or SUV) is airborne and flipping end-over-end, colliding with a wall and generating a large dust cloud; a black sports car is visible nearby but not yet impacted.
The flipping vehicle continues its rotation mid-air, descending toward the ground while the black Nissan Skyline R34 remains stationary in the foreground; debris and smoke are prominent.
The airborne vehicle impacts the ground violently near the blue Nissan Skyline, causing a massive dust/debris explosion; the blue car begins to swerve left to avoid collision.
The blue Nissan Skyline completes its evasive maneuver and drives past the crash site; the other vehicle is now on its side or roof, still emitting smoke/dust.
The blue car continues forward as the wrecked orange/yellow vehicle slides and tumbles further down the street; secondary impact debris is visible.
The orange/yellow vehicle flips again and crashes into another object or wall, sending up more dust; the blue car is now ahead and clear of immediate danger.
The wreckage continues sliding and rotating across the road; the blue car is seen from behind, having passed the main impact zone.
The aftermath: the wrecked vehicle comes to rest on its side, smoking; the blue car has moved further down the street; no new collisions occur in this interval.
